name: reel-a-field-guide-parking-lot-coach
head: THE PARKING
LOT COACH
cover_sub: Lives about forty feet from the rink door.

entries.label: HABITAT
entries.text: Driver's seat. Engine running. Before and after every game.

entries.label: CALL
entries.text: "Did you see what I saw on that backcheck?"

entries.label: DIET
entries.text: Gas station coffee. Half a granola bar from the console.

entries.label: HOW TO SPOT
entries.text: Only one in the car still talking.

entries.label: BEHAVIOR
entries.text: Means every word. Kid's asleep by the second light.

end: Is usually me. Working on it.
follow: Follow for more from the rink.
